request.style: English, deep male baritone voice with gospel choir backing, Hammond organ, electric piano, cello, brushed snare drum, mournful and solemn mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
During his reign the king of Babylon invaded
Jehoiakim served him for three years
Then he turned and rebelled against the master
The LORD sent raiding bands against the land

[Chorus]
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon my servant
I will bring them against this land
To devote them to destruction
An object of horror and scorn

[Verse]
All who see you will recoil from you
Nineveh is ruined who will mourn
Are you better than Thebes seated by the Nile
Yet she too went into exile

[Chorus]
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon my servant
I will bring them against this land
To devote them to destruction
An object of horror and scorn

[Bridge]
This whole land will become a ruin
A wasteland for seventy years
The sound of joy will be banished
From the city and the fields

[Outro]
I will punish the king of Babylon
And that nation for their guilt
The land of Chaldeans made a desolation
